title: The standby facility a Swiss pension foundation should elect for its private-markets programme's 2027 capital calls, with the fees at the two nearest amounts and the 2026 distributions received by strategy and quarter
subdomain: liquidity, funding and balance-sheet risk (a private-markets programme's capital-call forecast against a standby facility)
prompt_shape: 07 (a dial setting): the facility amount from the menu, with the fees at it and at the next amount down, and every strategy's 2026 distributions received in each quarter and for the year

No real person, fund, company or record is depicted; exchange-rate paths are synthetic.
